name: Landing Hull
desc: The ship you came down in. Houses 40, makes a little power and heat, salvages 1 alloy a turn from its own hull, and anchors the heat network.

name: Heat Main
desc: Insulated conduit. Extends the network so you can build further out.

name: Shaft
desc: A shaft down to the Deep. When it is finished it opens a landing below, joined to the surface; build outward from there. Can't be dug above solid bedrock.

name: Shaft Landing
desc: The bottom of a shaft. Joins the Deep to the surface.

name: Mirror Field
desc: Power from sunlight. Output scales with light: weak on the night side, strong toward the day side.

name: Vent Tap
desc: Caps a geothermal vent. A large, steady supply of heat. Must sit on a vent.

name: Ice Drill
desc: Melts ice into water. Must sit on ice.

name: Splitter
desc: Splits water into breathable oxygen.

name: Kelp Vat
desc: Warm tanks of edible kelp. Needs plenty of heat.

name: Bunkhouse
desc: Houses 12. Only counts while it is heated and powered.

name: Seam Cutter
desc: Cuts ore from a mineral seam. Must sit on a seam.

name: Forge
desc: Smelts ore into alloy, the colony's building material and main export. Gives off a little heat.

name: Launch Rail
desc: Fires alloy to orbit for sale: up to 4 per turn, keeping your export reserve back. This is how you pay the Company.

name: Commons
desc: Somewhere warm to eat together. Raises morale.

name: Clinic
desc: Halves deaths from age, illness and shortages, and raises morale a little.

name: Cache
desc: Adds 300 storage for each stored resource. Works unpowered.

name: Survey Lab
desc: Produces 1 research a turn (more with high morale). During a plague, its research goes to the cure first.

name: Workshop
desc: Repair crews. Each Workshop takes one more turn off every repair in progress.

name: Warden Post
desc: Keeps order. Each post holds crime down by 8 points.

name: Fusion Core
desc: A contained fusion reactor. A huge, steady supply of power and some heat, day or night, storm or not. Needs the Contained Fusion research.

name: Beam Catcher
desc: A receiving grid for power beamed down from orbit. Each power satellite you have launched gives one Catcher 10 power (up to 2 satellites per Catcher). Needs the Power Beaming research.

name: Reclaimer
desc: Breaks down the colony's waste: up to 5 a turn, recovering some ore and water. Waste left lying around lowers morale and helps plague spread.

name: Fab Shop
desc: Machines alloy into parts: the precise pieces drones, satellites and the most advanced buildings need. It pauses while the colony holds 40 parts, so it never wastes alloy.

name: Drone Bay
desc: Builds and runs work drones. Each working Drone Bay controls up to 4 drones; drones beyond that sit idle. Order drones from the Drones & Orbit panel.

name: Signal Mast
desc: A tall antenna. News and messages from home raise morale a little, and better market news gets 1 more mark for each alloy the Launch Rails sell (up to 3 masts count).

name: Rescue Station
desc: Emergency crews and braces. While one is working, disasters (seal failures and icequakes) damage half as many buildings.

name: Academy
desc: Trains workers into specialists. Specialists make Forges, Fab Shops, Seam Cutters and labs work better (up to +15% when 30% of adults are trained).

name: Hazard Lab
desc: Risky experiments behind thick walls. Three times the research of a Survey Lab, but it lowers morale and breaks down often.

name: Garden Cavern
desc: A lit, green park in the Deep with a pond and fruit trees. A big lift to morale, and a little food. Deep only.

name: Lounge
desc: Music, games and a bar. A big lift to morale, but it costs 3 marks a turn to run and draws some trouble (crime +4).
